decision.fail: Any mismatch, timeout, failed release gate, missing phase-2 evidence, harness error, wrong effect, duplicate attempt or cleanup uncertainty is FAIL_OR_UNKNOWN. Phase 2 does not start unless the strict phase-1 gate passes.
decision.pass: Phase 1 passes every frozen strict release check, including cancel response, 1250 ms callback hold, at least 21 same-call result polls, independent same-generation Q-up witness and bounded cleanup; then phase 2 passes exact task effect, oracle binding and neutral-release checks.
decision.stop: One dispatch and at most one cancel in phase 1; one dispatch and one oracle verification in phase 2; no retry or replay. CUA activation waits are bounded to 120 seconds per phase.

instrumentation.mode: R35 adds a finite 10 ms independent same-generation state series process, started before dispatch, to avoid post-event process startup latency. retry_policy: One input-free frozen-source/predecessor preflight immediately before a fresh paired attempt. Each phase waits for its unique CUA activation receipt and independent foreground/process-owner match before public calls. On any error or timeout, retain evidence and never retry.

scope.question: Can the native supervised caller release input within the frozen bounded-cancel protocol and, in the same attempt, complete one exact task on a distinct fresh fixture generation with an independent oracle receipt?

scope.stop: If phase 1 is not STRICT_RELEASE_PASS, do not start phase 2. Preserve all evidence. Any mismatch or cleanup uncertainty is FAIL_OR_UNKNOWN.
